backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing items, conversations, user profiles, and feedback with authorization and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a frontend change to use the caller-scoped feedback endpoint.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files for reference and build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration with authenticated layout and routes including feedback.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting new users to enter a display name with validation and profile saving.
frontend/src/components/conversations/Co: Conversation list card showing the other participant, item context, last message, and timestamp.
frontend/src/components/conversations/Me: Provides a message input form with Enter-to-send behavior that submits messages via useSendMessage and handles errors with toasts.
frontend/src/components/conversations/St: Renders a button to create a new conversation for an item and navigates to it, unless the item belongs to the current user.
frontend/src/components/items/ItemCard.t: Displays an item preview card with photo, metadata, and status, and navigates to the item detail page when clicked.
frontend/src/components/items/PhotoPicke: Handles image selection, validation, preview, and upload progress, emitting an ExternalBlob or null to the parent.
frontend/src/components/items/StatusUpda: Allows authorized users to change an item's status via a select input and update button with mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with branding, browsing and reporting links, inbox access, and user profile dropdown.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with a header, main content area, and footer including attribution and year display.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConversations.ts: Provides polling queries for user conversations and individual conversation details using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the caller’s user profile and role using the actor, exposing loading and fetched state helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useFeedback.ts: Fetches caller feedback entries and provides a mutation for submitting new feedback with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and status tracking. Wraps AuthClient setup and exposes identity and login state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating items, conversations, messages, and related data via the backend actor. Handles caching, polling, and invalidation for item searches, conversations, and updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind CSS layers and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for colors, radius, borders, and UI tokens. Applies global background and text styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App. Imports global CSS.
frontend/src/pages/BrowsePage.tsx: Implements the item browsing UI with search, category filters, and lost/found tabs, using useSearchItems to fetch matching items. Displays results, loading state, or empty-state messaging.
frontend/src/pages/ConversationPage.tsx: Displays a single conversation with messages, participant info, and safety alert; fetches conversation, item, and user profile data. Allows navigation back to inbox and message composition.
frontend/src/pages/FeedbackPage.tsx: Provides a feedback submission form with validation and list of past submissions, using feedback hooks to load and submit data. Shows success and error states with formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/InboxPage.tsx: Displays the user's conversations, showing a loader, empty state, or list depending on fetch state.
frontend/src/pages/ItemDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed item info, computes match suggestions, and allows navigation and status or conversation actions.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with login, hero content, and feature explanations for the platform.
frontend/src/pages/ReportItemPage.tsx: Form page for reporting lost or found items with validation, photo upload, and item creation flow.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Maps backend or thrown errors to user-friendly messages with special handling for common cases.
frontend/src/utils/identity.ts: Provides helpers for principal formatting, initials extraction, and equality checks.
frontend/src/utils/textSimilarity.ts: Implements tokenization, Jaccard-like similarity scoring, and keyword extraction for text matching.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/validation.ts: Basic validators for required fields, min length, and photo type/size checks.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color tokens, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, architecture notes, and feature list for a lost-and-found web app MVP.
